subject: physical-education

location.unitTitle: Capstone: Adult Lifetime Movement Plan and Defense
location.courseTitle: Lifelong Wellness and Independent Training Capstone

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of integrating four years of evidence into one working plan in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe stating the reasoning behind each element using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply the access, cost, and time plan that makes it real in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving the review points and the conditions that trigger revision; correct it and explain why.
Connect defending the plan under questioning with revising after critique without abandoning the plan and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Present the adult lifetime movement plan to one trusted adult, defend every element with reasoning and evidence from the four-year portfolio, and produce a revised final version.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Capstone: Adult Lifetime Movement Plan and Defense?
